productRules.rule: Credentials, secrets, private keys, access tokens, and session cookies are never stored; uploads are scanned for them before content becomes available.

When a secret is detected in an upload, the upload moves to rejected with reason secret_detected, its content is purged immediately, and only a tombstone (content hash, size, uploader, time, reason) is kept.
A secret-bearing (secret_detected) upload can never be released, quarantined, or made available; the uploader must submit a redacted replacement as a new upload.

Evidence artifact states are pending_inspection, available, quarantined (reason malware), rejected (reason secret_detected or invalid, content purged), and disposed; every upload must be scanned for malware and secrets before it becomes available.
A quarantined artifact cannot be downloaded or shared; only an Org Admin may release a malware false positive (a recorded decision after rescan) or dispose of it.
Evidence content identity (hash) is verified on restore.

decides: Rejects an upload with reason secret_detected, purges its content immediately, and keeps only a tombstone (content hash, size, uploader, time, reason); credentials, private keys, access tokens, and session cookies are never stored. A quarantined (malware) artifact cannot be downloaded or shared, and only an Org Admin may release a false positive after rescan or dispose of it. Content hash is verified on restore.
